answer_2.quote: Existing automatic evaluation approaches fall short fundamentally: previous metrics like BLEU and METEOR, and later embedding-based approaches such as BERTScore and BLEURT...

answer_3.quote: LITRANSPROQA integrates humans in the loop... We query answers for all 45 questions. Using Vanilla template defined above... answers each question with Yes, No or Maybe.

answer_4.quote: We recruit professional translators to conduct a survey... Seven professional literary translators... are hired from Upwork. The translators rate each question...
